settings.overlay_text: Introducing the future of comfort and precision in ballet footwear
Introducing the future of comfort and precision in ballet footwear.

settings.text: Meet Elation, Bloch's new ballet shoe that sets a new standard for precision and comfort, loved by dancers worldwide. Elation - Bloch's innovation to enhance your performance.

settings.title: All new split sole design
settings.text: The combination of innovative stretch lining and premium stretch canvas upper not only offers supreme comfort but also allows the wearer full freedom to spread their toes.

settings.title: Distinct left & right feet
settings.text: The asymmetrical suede outsole completes the shoe, ensuring elegance and durability.

settings.title: Ultra sleek profile
settings.text: Elation extends the line of the foot, ensuring aesthetic meets comfort.

"My Elation ballet flats feel like a second skin. They are soft, flexible, and incredibly comfortable to work in.

Because they are so light, you feel free and able to move with ease. The subtle padding underneath is placed perfectly, offering just the right amount of support without bulk. I also love how aesthetically pleasing they are, giving a beautiful, clean line to my foot that enhances every movement."

- Yasmine Naghdi, Bloch Ambassador, Principal Dancer.

I love these shoes! They’re the best flat shoes I’ve ever worn (and I’ve worn a
few!). They support the foot without hindering the movement, and feel like
socks! The material is also extremely soft, which, for me, encourages articulation of the foot on the floor.

The Elation ballet flats have changed the way I work through my feet in class. The
snug fit with stretchy canvas really allows me to articulate through my whole
foot and give them a nice shape.
